# Domain Rules

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

### Overview

- Domain = a portfolio content model + a set of client-side interactive behaviors. No business transactions, no persistence.
- Content is data-driven: copy, timeline entries, stat targets, and tech tags all live in `locales/{pt,en}.json`; components render from them.
- Two locales, PT default, must stay structurally identical (enforced by tests).

### Locale parity rule

`locales/en.json` and `locales/pt.json` must share the same top-level key set, equal-length `about.timeline` arrays, and required nested keys (`hero.role1/2/3`, `hero.statTargets.{years,projects,commits}`, `project.euNoPlay.{tags,cta}`, `contact.social.{github,linkedin,email}.handle`). Implemented/verified in `tests/unit/i18nKeys.test.ts`. Extend: add the key to both JSON files before referencing via `$t`.

### Default locale + URL strategy

PT is default and served at root (no prefix); EN served under `/en`. Config: `nuxt.config.ts` `i18n.defaultLocale: 'pt'`, `strategy: 'prefix_except_default'`, locales `pt` (`pt-BR`) / `en` (`en-US`). Extend: add a locale object + `<code>.json` under `locales/`.

### Typewriter role cycling (HeroSection)

Cycles through roles with a 3-phase state machine. Reference logic in `tests/unit/typewriter.test.ts` (`tickTypewriter`), backing `HeroSection.vue`.

| Phase    | Condition                  | Next state                                                |
| -------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| typing   | `charIndex < role.length`  | append 1 char, stay `typing`                              |
| typing   | `charIndex == role.length` | → `pause`                                                 |
| pause    | always                     | → `deleting`                                              |
| deleting | `charIndex > 0`            | remove 1 char, stay `deleting`                            |
| deleting | `charIndex == 0`           | reset, `roleIdx = (roleIdx+1) % roles.length`, → `typing` |

Empty `roles` array → typing immediately finishes to `pause` (no throw). Extend: add `hero.roleN` keys in both locales.

### Rolling-buffer capture animation (ProjectSection)

Simulates a 25-second rolling camera buffer. `bufferPercent = ((25 - countdown) / 25) * 100` (0% at reset, 100% at countdown 0; `ProjectSection.vue`, `tests/unit/bufferPercent.test.ts`).

| Event                        | Behavior                                                                                             |
| ---------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Section becomes visible      | Start 1s `setInterval`; update clock, decrement `countdown`                                          |
| `countdown <= 1` on tick     | Run capture sequence, reset `countdown = 25`                                                         |
| Capture click / auto-capture | `isRecording=true`, `showReplay=true`; after 1500ms stop recording; after further 2000ms hide replay |
| Component unmount            | Clear interval + all timeouts                                                                        |

Clock formats via `toLocaleTimeString` with `pt-BR`/`en-US` from active locale; guarded by `import.meta.client`.

### Scroll-triggered reveal (all sections)

Sections observe viewport entry with `useIntersectionObserver` (threshold 0.1) and flip an `isVisible`/`sectionVisible` ref once to trigger enter transitions. Verified in `ProjectSection.vue` and `ContactSection.vue`. One-way latch — no re-hide on scroll-out.

### SEO / Schema.org rule

`app/pages/index.vue` sets locale-aware `title`/`description` (EN vs PT branches on `locale.value`) and emits a single `definePerson` JSON-LD node: name `Werlesson`, jobTitle `Fullstack Developer`, `knowsAbout` [Vue 3, Laravel, Nuxt 3, TypeScript, PHP], `sameAs` GitHub + LinkedIn. `url` normalized from `useSiteConfig().url` stripping trailing slash, falling back to `https://werlesson.dev`.

### Contact form (client-only)

`ContactSection.vue` collects `{name, email, message}` in a reactive object; `onSubmit` sets `submitted=true` (via `requestAnimationFrame`) — no network request, no backend. Direct contact via `socialLinks` (GitHub, LinkedIn, `mailto:werlesson@email.com`).
